page.overview:
Who is 214736184505796?

214736184505796 was the designation of a clone trooper created on the planet Kamino to serve the Galactic Republic as a member of the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems, Made from the genetic template of the Human bounty hunter Jango Fett, 214736184505796 was a male clone who stood at 1.83 meters tall and had tan skin. The trooper wore Phase I clone trooper armor and carried a blaster rifle.

214736184505796 was mentioned in the 2002 reference book Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Scrapbook by Ryder Windham, where they were labeled as CLONE TROOPER NO. 214736184505796.

Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Scrapbook
